ns2:section.sectionText: Sociology of News - Production and Content: Examines the media logics that convey, shape, and define public life. Particular attention will be paid to how succeeding theorists critique/extend earlier explanations of news production, what evidence is used in specific research studies, and the limitations of evidence/analysis presented in individual papers for understanding news production/content. The final course project will be a research proposal prepared using the guidelines for submission to a social science or humanities granting agency
